name: workbench-palette:markdown
description: AC-28 (coordinated palette) and the theme half of AC-27 for the Theo workbench, evaluated per surface per palette profile from rendered observations of the live story. Each check names the surfaces that draw its role; a surface that does not draw a role is not scored on it.

profiles.mapping: Neutral = github-sharp, Paper = stone, Forest = vitesse (the app's PALETTES); every palette in light and dark. Slate has no profile of its own: the terminal's slate is github-sharp's cool tint.

fixed_roles.success: Terminal ANSI green and the added marker are GitHub Dark's token colour (terminal-roles.ts, githubDarkTheme), kept so test output reads as a terminal does.
fixed_roles.link: GitHub Dark's link blue, kept as the mention colour in every profile.
fixed_roles.warning: pi slate's gold (terminal-theme.ts SLATE.gold), held at its slate hue and shifted only as far as readability on the profile's surfaces requires (status()).
fixed_roles.error: pi slate's error red (SLATE.error), same rule as warning.
fixed_roles.accent: pi slate's sage (SLATE.sage), the code and accent-text colour, same rule as warning.
fixed_roles.syntax: The syntax roles are githubDarkTheme.tokens constants (terminal-roles.ts); the diff hues are GitHub Dark's red and green hues placed at a lightness that follows the profile's background.

classes.standard: a published threshold the interface must meet
classes.contract: a statement about the build that must hold
classes.target: a goal; a miss is review, not a failure
classes.diagnostic: reported with its number, never a verdict
